notes.subject: de foatenfoa
notes.rationale: Exact date prescribed: fourteenth day of the month.

notes.subject: namel long tupela arapmun
notes.rationale: בין הערבים literally 'between the two evenings' (dual); rendered literally — rabbinic reading 'afternoon' vs Karaite/samaritan 'dusk to dark'.

notes.subject: yupela
notes.rationale: Direct plural address to Israel prescribing the rite.

notes.subject: תעשו אתו ... תעשו אתו
notes.rationale: Verbal repetition frames the statutes; preserved by repeating 'yupela bai wokim ⟨את⟩ em'.

translation: Long de foatenfoa bilong dispela mun, namel long tupela arapmun, yupela bai wokim ⟨את⟩ em long taim bilong en bilong ol i makim; olsem olgeta lo bilong en na olsem olgeta pasin bilong skelim bilong en, yupela bai wokim ⟨את⟩ em.

tokens.gloss: long taim bilong en bilong ol i makim
